column1: # Mappings Mondo asserts that we do not trust. SSSOM cannot express a retraction,
# so they live here and `build_value_sets.py` drops them before building a value set.
# Every row needs an open issue proposing the fix upstream.

column6: D57.2 is Hb-SC disease, a specific compound heterozygous genotype and a Mondo child of this term, not sickle cell disease in general. Leaving it in yields a seven-code value set containing no Hb-SS disease.

M33 subdivides into M33.0x juvenile dermatomyositis, M33.1x other dermatomyositis, M33.2x polymyositis and M33.9x unspecified. Polymyositis is a distinct disease, so M33 is broader than this term and pulls the wrong patients.
